json.take: Looking for that extra pass sounds neat on paper, but a short simulation horizon hides how fast passing lanes close down in the real world after a high turnover. Bastian Sandoval makes the sensible choice by taking the shot that is actually in front of him instead of gambling on a hypothetical sequence that assumes defenders will not adapt.
